08 / Marketplace

Nitro Garage — An automotive service and spare parts marketplace

Driver, mechanic and store on one platform — four roles, 79+ screens.

Year
2026
Scope
Marketplace
  • 79+
    screens across four roles
  • 4
    user roles
  • 3
    languages — AZ / RU / EN

01 / Overview

Nitro Garage is a mobile app digitising Azerbaijan’s car service market. It connects drivers, mechanics and spare-parts stores on one platform: drivers post service or part requests, and mechanics and stores send real-time bids so the cheapest option can be chosen.

02 / The problem

Drivers call stores one by one to compare part prices, do not know a mechanic’s workload, and struggle to find help when stranded. The market lacks price transparency.

03 / Our approach

A tender model — one request, many offers. Separate navigators and screen sets were built for four roles: driver, mechanic, store and admin. A geolocation-based SOS flow covers emergencies.

04 / The result

Drivers get several offers from one request and compare prices. Stores sell inventory with auto-bid rules, and mechanics manage their bookings through the app.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Service marketplace

    Drivers post requests; mechanics and stores bid.

  • 02

    SOS roadside assistance

    Nearby mechanics are alerted automatically using geolocation.

  • 03

    VIN scanner

    Camera and OCR identify the vehicle.

  • 04

    AI assistant

    Diagnostics plus service and part recommendations.

  • 05

    Wallet and cashback

    Transaction history, refunds and per-role balances.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. Role-based navigation

    Fully separate navigators and screens for each role.

  2. Service layer per domain

    Each backend domain has its own service layer, all going through one central axios client with JWT injection and token refresh.

  3. Deliberate state choices

    Zustand stores for cross-screen state, useState for local state — Redux deliberately not used.
